def transform(df):
    df = df.copy()
    q1 = df['Age'].quantile(0.25)
    q3 = df['Age'].quantile(0.75)
    iqr = q3 - q1
    lower_bound = q1 - 1.5 * iqr
    upper_bound = q3 + 1.5 * iqr

c1.code:
def transform(df):
    df = df.copy()
    q1 = df['Age'].quantile(0.25)
    q3 = df['Age'].quantile(0.75)
    iqr = q3 - q1
    lower_bound = q1 - 1.5 * iqr
    upper_bound = q3 + 1.5 * iqr
    df['Age'] = np.where((df['Age'] < lower_bound) | (df['Age'] > upper_bound), np.nan, df['Age'])
    return df

    df[col] = df[col].where(~mask_high, np.nan)
    return df
